purpose: Planning-only capability classification template; not a runtime capability manifest, native API map or authority grant.
merge_rule: For each requirements entry, shallow-merge over entry_template. Null/unknown means unestablished, not unsupported. IDs name project requirements, never TPF3 function names. Preferred ownership is policy intent, not demonstrated availability.

requirements.project_need: Actual game/mod build, loaded save identity and load epoch
Verified native-to-engineering coordinate transform
Bounded ports, connectivity and required/forbidden movements
Bounded terrain facts needed for engineering, with coverage/uncertainty
Actual available asset capabilities and native identity
Native track construction, snapping and validity/collision decisions
Native bridges/tunnels and authorised terrain realisation
Fresh committed realised geometry for engineering acceptance
Native pathfinding and required route availability
Reconcile ambiguous semantic submission/effects within a healthy running session; no crash-job continuation guarantee
Bounded relevant state changes and error normalisation
Authoritative motion/traversal observation when separately authorised
Native lifecycle/removal under explicit effect and protection policy
Native proposed geometry, validity and bounded side effects
Native reservation/signalling semantics where exposed
Native passenger behaviour, not a new Python simulation
Ordinary save/load identity changes and demonstrated railway-operation recovery while TPF3 stays healthy; no process restart or crash recovery
Canonical identity to exact native entity plus in-session load epoch; fresh inspection after ordinary save/load and preview reacquisition
Qualified profiles, geometry/topology alternatives, fit/holding, hard constraints and bounded search
Intent/preview/committed comparison, explicit protection/function policies and bounded repair
Derived bounded observations invalidated by build/save/load/state changes; not workflow continuation across crashes
Cheap conflict/clearance/terrain/civil approximations only when useful before native preview
Native-mechanic substitute only after a demonstrated gap and measurable quality/safety/GPT benefit

notes: No entry claims demonstrated native support. Unsupported requires build/scope-specific negative evidence.
Python offline acceptance is retained separately; it is not native evidence for these categories.
First survey is read-only; native mutation stays blocked pending successful capability/identity/terrain/topology/asset probes and separate authority.
State preservation labels PROTECTED/FUNCTION_ONLY/REPLACEABLE/REDEVELOPABLE/ENGINE_DELEGATED belong to the brief/effect scope, not inferred from capability rows or snapshot existence.
No fallback implementation, binding or refactor is authorised by this template.

runtime_scope.on_unavailable: Stop current job; external intervention required. No environment diagnostics, retries, watchdogs or remediation.
runtime_scope.recovery_scope: Finite authorised railway-semantic retries in a healthy session only; ordinary in-session save/load requires fresh inspection.
runtime_scope.persistence_scope: Engineering evidence, result history and in-session semantic operation reconciliation/deduplication; no crash-resilient workflow continuation.
runtime_scope.status: Production policy only; no native/runtime implementation or demonstration claimed.
